title: Cosmic Portal Guardians
description: A blue winged demon with horns stands beside a muscular warrior holding a glowing sword, both observing a swirling purple and orange cosmic portal containing a small purple rat. In the background, a large black dragon with glowing green eyes emerges from a stone archway marked with Roman numerals and melting clock elements, surrounded by pink petals and green lightning.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene featuring a blue-skinned winged demon with horns standing next to a muscular barbarian warrior holding a glowing sword on clouds. They gaze at a swirling colorful cosmic portal with a small purple rat floating inside. Behind them a massive black dragon with glowing green eyes emerges from a stone archway with Roman numerals and melting clock details, green lightning cracks, pink petals falling through a dramatic sky, epic composition, vibrant colors.
